literal: The things intended, as intended, they will attain, those who intended, firm people, to become, if they achieve.
translation: Those who plan will achieve exactly what they planned, if they possess the firmness of mind to carry it out.
modern: எண்ணியவர்கள் மன உறுதி உடையவர்களாக இருக்கப் பெற்றால், அவர்கள் எண்ணிய செயல்களை எண்ணியபடியே அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that mere planning is not enough; firmness of mind is required to see a plan through. The word 'எண்ணிய' refers to the goals or actions planned, while 'எண்ணியாங்கு' means achieving them exactly as envisioned. The condition for this success is 'திண்ணியர் ஆகப் பெறின்', meaning one must possess unwavering determination.
